name: diskcleankit
description: MCP server for DiskCleanKit - Mac disk cleaning with One Touch Clean
author: Mitsoftwarelab

queries.name: disk_status
queries.description: Get current disk space status including total, free, used space and health status

queries.name: cleaning_history
queries.description: Get cleaning history and statistics from previous One Touch Clean sessions

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of sessions to return (default: 20)

queries.name: cleanable_estimate
queries.description: Estimate how much space can be cleaned with One Touch Clean

actions.name: one_touch_scan
actions.description: Run DiskCleanKit One Touch Scan - scans for junk files (safe mode, nothing deleted). Always run this first.

actions.name: one_touch_clean
actions.description: Run DiskCleanKit One Touch Clean - cleans items from previous scan immediately (no confirmation). Run scan first and get user approval.

response_location.description: MCP responses are copied to clipboard and saved to temp file

example_queries.description: Run One Touch Clean (auto scan and clean)
